scope.summary: The focused g0002 gap is plausible, but the supplied evidence does not establish the effective nesting limit under the delegated CMake configuration. The supplied scope cannot be affirmed sufficient.

assessments.reason: The packet restricts candidate assessment to the g0002 focus candidate; g0001 is not adjudicated here.

The new object-print depth guard and the parser’s matching limit support the proposed unreachable route. The recipe delegates configuration to CMake, whose contents were not supplied, so the frozen depth-1000 condition is not established.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing applies the same nesting-limit macro before entering an object.
The header sets 1000 only when configuration has not defined the macro.
The build recipe delegates compilation to CMake.

build.reason: The recipe invokes CMake and links libcjson.a, but the root CMake configuration was not supplied.

evidence.dependency_reason: The old build script invokes the project recipe.

input.reason: Four binary flag bytes and a final NUL permit a JSON payload; the parser receives the payload and the termination flag.

evidence.dependency_reason: The called parser derives the length from the NUL-terminated payload.

lifecycle.reason: On the normal allocation path, the entry frees printed text and the minify copy, then deletes the parsed tree; parse failure deletes its partial tree.

evidence.dependency_reason: The parser releases a partial item on failure.
cJSON_Delete recursively releases the parsed tree.

control_flow.reason: A successful parse reaches one of three print variants; each dispatches objects to print_object. Optional minification runs afterward on a separate text copy.

evidence.dependency_reason: The other print variants use print_value through print.

missing_information: The contents of repository-relative CMakeLists.txt are needed to establish whether the build overrides CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.

assessment.requirement: Make the supported rejection of a constructible object at print depth 1000 reachable from the read target.
assessment.target_route: Four valid flag bytes and a NUL-terminated JSON payload → cJSON_ParseWithOpts → a selected print variant → print_value → print_object.
assessment.failure_condition: If the effective limit is 1000, a chain of 1001 objects can reach print_object’s new rejection when constructed directly, while the target’s parser rejects its 1001st object before printing.
assessment.alternative_paths: All selected print variants receive the same parsed tree. The flags and later minify call do not construct or deepen it.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The public constructor creates object nodes.
Named child attachment has no depth guard.
The parser rejects an object when its depth reaches the effective limit.
The default limit is 1000, subject to a configuration override.

missing_information: Read CMakeLists.txt to determine the effective CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT for the supplied build.
